title: pulmonaria officinalis var. maculosa
intro: Pulmonaria officinalis var. maculosa, commonly known as spotted lungwort, is a perennial plant species in the family Boraginaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its ability to soothe respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of spotted lungwort include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and a demulcent, helping to protect and soothe mucous membranes, while also exhibiting antibacterial and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of spotted lungwort include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
